author: reek
body: The four operators were the only numeric comparisons that ignored their operand type: `IrEq` and `IrNotEq` beside them already resolved it and sent Real to `ucomisd`, and the vector comparisons took it too.

author: reek
body: Two different code paths reach a comparison and each had the defect separately, so each case below is asked twice. A comparison in condition position is FUSED into the branch (`is-fusable-int-comparison`, and `lir-cmp-whitelisted` in the LIR); a comparison whose result is passed on as a value is MATERIALISED by `emit-binary-op`. Testing only one shape would have left the other broken and looked green.

author: reek
body: Every line prints the fused answer then the value answer, and both must be the number the line names.
